verses.text: Our Savior, the Lord God, and our hope, Jesus Christ, as commanded by Jesus Christ, the Apostle Paul, who is a servant.
To Timothy, my true child in the faith: Grace, mercy, and peace from God our Father and Christ Jesus our Lord.

sections.title: Beware of the teachings of the deceitful.

verses.text: And as I journeyed to Macedonia, some sought to teach a different doctrine, and to lead away from the end of the narrative and from the history of the generations, that they might not be established in Ephesus; for such things bring forth strife; but in faith, they do not serve the glory of God.
The fulfillment of the commandment, however, is love that proceeds from a pure heart and from a good conscience and from sincere faith.
And among these, some speak without understanding or speak concerning them without knowledge, desiring to be teachers of the law, they have turned to vain discourse.
But indeed, if a man works according to the law, we know that the law is good.

This is for the lawless and disobedient, for the ungodly and for sinners, for the unholy and profane, for those who strike their fathers and mothers, for murderers and for whoremongers, for them that defile themselves with mankind, for menstealers, for liars, for perjured persons, and if there be any other thing that is contrary to sound doctrine; according to the glorious gospel of the blessed God, which was committed to my trust, knowing that the law was not made for the righteous, but for the lawless and disobedient.

sections.title: The offering of thanksgiving that Paul presented concerning the grace of God.

verses.text: I give thanks for the service, for He has made me steadfast, and for the strength He has granted me through our Lord Jesus Christ.
Though I was previously a blasphemer and a persecutor, He has shown me mercy for I acted in ignorance and without faith.
And the grace of our Lord abounds in Christ Jesus, accompanied by faith and love.
"Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners," a saying that is trustworthy and deserving of full acceptance; of whom I am the foremost.
Therefore, let us be an example to those who believe in Him for eternal life, that Jesus Christ may show all His patience towards me, and thus I have obtained mercy.
To the only God, who is immortal, invisible, the only wise King, be honor and glory forever and ever. Amen.
My son Timothy, according to the prophecies previously made concerning you, I urge you to fight the good fight, holding on to this command.
Let faith and a good conscience be with you; some have rejected these and suffered shipwreck in their faith.
Among these are Hymenaeus and Alexander, whom I have delivered to Satan, that they may learn not to blaspheme.

Therefore, let us dwell in peace and tranquility, serving the Lord God with reverence and humility, and let our prayers and supplications, as well as our thanksgiving, be made for all people, for rulers and for all authorities, that they may be accomplished before all.
It is good and pleasing before our God and Savior that all people should come to the knowledge of the truth.
There is one God; and there is one mediator between God and men, the man Christ Jesus.
He gave Himself as a ransom for all; this was the testimony given at the proper time.
For this reason, I was appointed a preacher and an apostle, I am telling the truth, I am not lying, a teacher of the Gentiles in faith and truth.
Likewise, let men everywhere lift up holy hands without anger or disputing.

Similarly, women should adorn themselves in proper clothing, with modesty and self-control, not with braided hair or gold or pearls or expensive clothes, but with good deeds, appropriate for women who profess to worship God.
A woman should learn in quietness and full submission.
I do not permit a woman to teach or to assume authority over a man; she must be quiet.
Adam was formed first, then Eve.
Adam was not deceived; however, the woman was deceived and fell into transgression.
Nevertheless, if they remain in faith and in love, sanctifying themselves, they shall be saved through childbearing.

sections.title: A guide to be worthy of being an apostle.

verses.text: "Whosoever shall seek the episcopate, let him desire a good work;" this saying is trustworthy.
Therefore, an episcopate ought to be such; unassailable, the husband of one wife, vigilant, self-controlled, of good behavior, hospitable, apt to teach,
not given to wine, not a striker, but gentle, not contentious, not a lover of money,
ruling his own house well, having his children in subjection with all gravity;
For if a man know not how to rule his own house, how shall he take care of the church of God?
Let him not be a novice, lest being lifted up with pride he fall into the condemnation of the devil.
Moreover, he must have a good report of them which are without; that he fall not into reproach and the snare of the devil.

sections.title: A guideline for one who desires to be a deacon.

verses.text: Likewise, deacons must be grave, not double-tongued, not given to much wine, not greedy for filthy lucre;
They must hold the mystery of the faith in a pure conscience.
And let these also first be proved; then let them use the office of a deacon, being found blameless.
Likewise, women must be grave, not slanderers, sober, faithful in all things.
Let deacons be the husbands of one wife, ruling their children and their own houses well.
For they that have used the office of a deacon well purchase to themselves a good degree, and great boldness in the faith which is in Christ Jesus.

sections.title: The great mystery of our faith.

verses.text: ፈጥኜ ወደ አንተ እንድመጣ ተስፋ አድርጌ ይህን እጽፍልሃለሁ።
ብዘገይ ግን፥ በእግዚአብሔር ማደሪያ ቤት መኖር እንዴት እንደሚገባ ታውቅ ዘንድ እጽፍልሃለሁ፤ ቤቱም የእውነት ዓምድና መሠረት፥ የሕያው እግዚአብሔር ቤተ ክርስቲያን ነው።
እግዚአብሔርንም የመምሰል ምሥጢር ያለ ጥርጥር ታላቅ ነው፤

"But the Spirit speaks expressly, that in the latter times some shall depart from the faith, giving heed to seducing spirits and doctrines of devils; they shall speak lies in hypocrisy, having their conscience seared with a hot iron." Thus it is said, as they are led by their own minds.
These wicked ones shall be cast out; they shall receive with falsehood those who know the truth, and they shall be ensnared to partake of the bread which the Lord has created.
For all that the Lord has created is good, and if they receive it with thanksgiving, nothing shall be rejected.
For it is sanctified by the word of God and prayer.

sections.title: Concerning being a good servant of Christ.

verses.text: Therefore, if you think of your brethren, you shall be a good servant of Jesus Christ, being nourished in faith and in the good teaching which you have followed.
However, far removed is this from the ways of the world and the games of the ungodly women. Yet, to emulate the Lord, do not neglect your own self.
For the body is of little use for carnal matters; yet to emulate the Lord, there is hope for both the present and the life to come, and it is beneficial for all things.
This saying is trustworthy and deserving of full acceptance;
To obtain this, we strive; therefore, we labor; this is because we hope in the living God, who is the Savior of all men, especially of those who believe.
Let this be your command and your teaching. In word and in life, in love and in faith, in purity, be an example to those who believe; let no one despise your youth.
Until I come, give attention to reading, to exhortation, to teaching; be diligent in these matters.
Do not neglect the gift that is in you, which was given to you through prophecy with the laying on of hands of the presbytery.
Consider this in all matters, that your progress may be evident to all; take heed to this.
Take heed to yourself and to your teaching; continue in these things, for in doing this you will save both yourself and those who hear you.

sections.title: Concerning the counsel given to the faithful.

verses.text: ሽማግሌ የሆነውን አትገሥጸው፤ እርሱን ግን እንደ አባት፥ ጎበዞችን እንደ ወንድሞች፥ የሸመገሉትን ሴቶች እንደ እናቶች፥ ቆነጃጅቱን እንደ እኅቶች በፍጹም ንጽሕና ለምናቸው።
በእውነት ባልቴቶች የሆኑትን ባልቴቶች አክብር።
ማንም ባልቴት ግን ልጆች ወይም የልጅ ልጆች ቢኖሩአት፥ እነርሱ አስቀድመው ለገዛ ቤተ ሰዎቻቸው እግዚአብሔርን መምሰል ያሳዩ ዘንድ፥ ለወላጆቻቸውም ብድራትን ይመልሱላቸው ዘንድ ይማሩ፤ ይህ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት መልካምና የተወደደ ነውና።
ብቻዋንም ኖራ በእውነት ባልቴት የምትሆን በእግዚአብሔር ተስፋ ታደርጋለች፤ ሌትና ቀንም በልመና በጸሎትም ጸንታ ትኖራለች፤
ቅምጥሊቱ ግን በሕይወትዋ ሳለች የሞተች ናት።
ያለ ነቀፋ እንዲሆኑ ይህን ደግሞ እዘዝ።
ነገር ግን ለእርሱ ስለ ሆኑት ይልቁንም ስለ ቤተ ሰዎቹ የማያስብ ማንም ቢሆን፥ ሃይማኖትን የካደ ከማያምንም ሰው ይልቅ የሚከፋ ነው።
ባልቴት በመዝገብ ብትጻፍ ዕድሜዋ ከስድሳ ዓመት እንዳያንስ፤ የአንድም ባል ሚስት የነበረች እንድትሆን ያስፈልጋል፤
ልጆችን በማሳደግ፥ እንግዶችንም በመቀበል፥ የቅዱሳንንም እግሮች በማጠብ፥ የተጨነቁትንም በመርዳት፥ በጎንም ሥራ ሁሉ በመከተል፥ ይህን መልካም ሥራ በማድረግ የተመሰከረላት ልትሆን ይገባል።
ባል የሞተባቸውን ቆነጃጅት ግን አትቀበል፤ በክርስቶስ ላይ ተነሥተው ሲቀማጠሉ ሊያገቡ ይወዳሉና፤
የፊተኛውንም እምነታቸውን ስለ ናቁ ይፈረድባቸዋል፤
ከዚህም ጋር ቤት ለቤት እየዞሩ ሥራን መፍታት ደግሞ ይማራሉ፤ የማይገባውንም እየተናገሩ ለፍላፊዎችና በነገር ገቢዎች ይሆናሉ እንጂ፥ ሥራ ፈቶች ብቻ አይደሉም።
እንግዲህ ቆነጃጅት ሊያገቡ፥ ልጆችንም ሊወልዱ፥ ቤቶቻቸውንም ሊያስተዳድሩ፥ ተቃዋሚውም የሚሳደብበትን አንድን ምክንያት ስንኳ እንዳይሰጡ እፈቅዳለሁ፤
ከአሁን በፊት አንዳንዶች ሰይጣንን እንዲከተሉ ፈቀቅ ብለዋልና።
ባልቴቶች ያሉት የሚያምን ቢሆን ወይም የምታምን ብትሆን፥ ይርዱአቸው፤ ቤተ ክርስቲያንም እውነተኞችን ባልቴቶች እንድትረዳ አይክበዱባት።
በመልካም የሚያስተዳድሩ ሽማግሌዎች፥ ይልቁንም በመስበክና በማስተማር የሚደክሙት፥ እጥፍ ክብር ይገባቸዋል።
መጽሐፍ “የሚያበራየውን በሬ አፉን አትሰር፤” ደግሞ “ለሠራተኛ ደመወዙ ይገባዋል፤” ይላልና።
ከሁለት ወይም ከሦስት ምስክር በቀር በሽማግሌ ላይ ክስ አትቀበል።
ሌሎቹ ደግሞ እንዲፈሩ፥ ኀጢአት የሚሠሩትን በሁሉ ፊት ገሥጻቸው።
አንድን እንኳ በአድልዎ ሳታደርግ፥ እነዚህን ያለ ማዘንበል እንድትጠብቅ በእግዚአብሔርና በጌታ በኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ በተመረጡትም መላእክት ፊት እመክርሃለሁ።
Do not hasten your hands upon any man; neither be thou partaker of the sins of others; keep thyself in purity.
Concerning thy belly and thy sickness, drink but a little wine; rather, let water alone be thy drink.
The sins of certain men are manifest, going before unto judgment; but the sins of others follow after.
Likewise, good works are also manifest; and that which is not manifest cannot be hidden.

sections.title: Servants shall serve their masters as it is fitting for them.

verses.text: The name of the Lord and His teaching shall not be despised; all the servants beneath the sun shall honor their masters with the respect that is due unto them.

Those who believe are their masters; let not the brethren be discouraged because they are brethren; rather, let them serve even more diligently, for they are esteemed and beloved because of their good works.

sections.title: The teaching of falsehood and true wealth.

verses.text: Teach and counsel these things. If anyone teaches a different doctrine than that which is sound, as it pertains to our Lord Jesus Christ, and does not consent to wholesome words, even the words of our Lord Jesus Christ, and to the doctrine which is according to godliness, let him not be received.

He has become puffed up with pride; he knows nothing; but is obsessed with disputes and arguments over words. From these come envy, strife, reviling, and evil suspicions, and constant friction between men of corrupt minds and destitute of the truth, who suppose that godliness is a means of gain. From such withdraw yourself.
"Let my life be sufficient," is indeed a great denial of God.
And to the world, we have not brought anything.
We cannot take anything with us; but if we have food and clothing, we shall be content.
But those who desire to be rich fall into temptation and a snare, and into many foolish and harmful lusts which drown men in destruction and perdition.
For the love of money is a root of all kinds of evil, for which some have strayed from the faith in their greediness, and pierced themselves through with many sorrows.

sections.title: To adorn the good path of faith.

verses.text: አንተ ግን የእግዚአብሔር ሰው ሆይ! ከዚህ ሽሽ፤ ጽድቅንና እግዚአብሔርን መምሰል እምነትንም ፍቅርንም መጽናትንም የዋህነትንም ተከታተል።
መልካሙን የእምነት ገድል ተጋደል፤ የተጠራህለትንም በብዙም ምስክሮች ፊት በመልካም መታመን የታመንህለትን የዘላለምን ሕይወት ያዝ።
ሁሉን በሕይወት በሚጠብቅ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት፥ በጴንጤናዊውም በጲላጦስ ዘንድ መልካሙን መታመን በመሰከረ በክርስቶስ ኢየሱስ ፊት አዝሃለሁ፤
ጌታችን ኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ እስኪገለጥ ድረስ ያለ እድፍና ያለ ነቀፋ ሆነህ ትእዛዙን ጠብቅ፤
ያንም መገለጡን በራሱ ጊዜ ብፁዕና ብቻውን የሆነ ገዥ፥ የነገሥታት ንጉሥና የጌቶች ጌታ ያሳያል።
እርሱ ብቻ የማይሞት ነው፤ ማንም ሊቀርበው በማይችል ብርሃን ይኖራል፤ አንድ ሰው እንኳ አላየውም፤ ሊያይም አይቻለውም፤ ለእርሱ ክብርና የዘላለም ኀይል ይሁን፤ አሜን።
በአሁኑ ዘመን ባለ ጠጎች የሆኑት የትዕቢትን ነገር እንዳያስቡ ደስም እንዲለን ሁሉን አትርፎ በሚሰጠን በሕያው እግዚአብሔር እንጂ፥ በሚያልፍ ባለ ጠግነት ተስፋ እንዳያደርጉ እዘዛቸው።
እውነተኛውን ሕይወት ይይዙ ዘንድ፥ ለሚመጣው ዘመን ለራሳቸው መልካም መሠረት የሚሆንላቸውን መዝገብ እየሰበሰቡ መልካምን እንዲያደርጉ፤ በበጎም ሥራ ባለ ጠጎች እንዲሆኑ፤ ሊረዱና ሊያካፍሉም የተዘጋጁ እንዲሆኑ ምከራቸው።
ጢሞቴዎስ ሆይ! በውሸት እውቀት ከተባለ ለዓለም ከሚመች ከከንቱ መለፍለፍና መከራከር እየራቅህ የተሰጠህን አደራ ጠብቅ፤
ይህ እውቀት አለን ብለው አንዳንዶች ስለ እምነት ስተዋልና። ጸጋ ከአንተ ጋር ይሁን።
